name: Ense (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Ense (a bell above a wall over red and yellow bars).
history: Municipal flag of Ense; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Ense arms — bell, wall and bars
